name: Spell Subterfuge

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: After casting a spell with an action and a slot, a Bonus Action lets you both Dash and Hide. Uses equal the modifier of the ability this feat raised, per Long Rest. While Invisible from Hide, casting a Verbal spell or making a spell attack doesn't reveal you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.

benefits.name: Shrouding Spells
benefits.summary: After casting a spell with an action and a slot, a Bonus Action lets you both Dash and Hide. Uses equal the modifier of the ability this feat raised, per Long Rest.
benefits.text: Right after you cast a spell with a casting time of an action using a spell slot, you can take a Bonus Action to both Dash and Hide. You can do this a number of times equal to the modifier of the ability this feat increased (minimum once), regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Sneaky Casting
benefits.summary: While Invisible from Hide, casting a Verbal spell or making a spell attack doesn't reveal you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.
benefits.text: While you have the Invisible condition from the Hide action, casting a spell with a Verbal component or making a spell attack roll doesn't end it, as long as you finish that turn with Three-Quarters or Total Cover from every enemy.
